title: Separate Black and White Balls
summary: Given a binary string s of length n representing black (1) and white (0) balls, determine the least number of adjacent swaps needed to move all black balls to the right and all white balls to the left.
statement: Given a binary string s of length n representing black (1) and white (0) balls, determine the least number of adjacent swaps needed to move all black balls to the right and all white balls to the left.
constraints: s is a nonempty binary string where one is black and zero is white.
Return the minimum swaps needed to place every zero before every one.
hints: Each black-before-white inversion must cross once under adjacent swaps.
Scan left to right, counting prior black balls; every white ball contributes that count.
Increment black on one, otherwise add black to the answer.
An adjacent swap fixes exactly one inversion, and bubble movement can fix all inversions in that many swaps, so the inversion count is both lower bound and attainable.

The black ball crosses both following white balls in two swaps.
